description: This file declares functions and structures related to interactive rebase operations within a version control system, likely Git. It includes function prototypes for managing todo lists, appending help information, and checking the consistency of todo lists.

methods.name: append_todo_help
methods.description: Appends help information for rebase commands into the provided string buffer, utilizing command count and revision information.

methods.name: edit_todo_list
methods.description: Edits the rebase todo list, possibly allowing user interaction or modifications, based on repository state and options.

methods.name: todo_list_check
methods.description: Checks the validity or consistency of a new todo list against an old one.

methods.name: todo_list_check_against_backup
methods.description: Validates the current todo list against a backup version within the context of the repository and replay options.
